input.content: STAGE 1 - SCOPE CHECK (rubric rank-2026-10-v1). GOAL: test all four proposals against the five scope criteria using the frozen bundles. READ: CURVCTRL-SID (bundle 61bfdc6f1780e904), behcone-prefix-rq (9768fd6894a0783b), succboost-geoshift (45cb4724a3d051b0), LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ (252d0d1a393713ba), items E1-E13 of each. OBSERVED: CURVCTRL-SID and succboost-geoshift state behaviour_on/off and geometry_on/off switches explicitly and place behaviour inside the assignment metric or the quantized point; LORENTZ changes the quantized point but the frozen text gives no off switches (only alpha=0.5) and defers equations; behcone keeps the RQ-VAE quantizer unchanged and adds a behaviour-conditioned cone penalty on the level-1 codebook, with switch definitions deferred to an unshown SPEC EQUATIONS. REASONING: on scope criteria 1-3 all four are in programme; criterion 4 (the three switches are part of the mechanism) is fully met only by CURVCTRL-SID and succboost-geoshift. Coupling strength ordering: CURVCTRL (behaviour sets curvature) > LORENTZ/succboost (behaviour sets the point) > behcone (auxiliary codebook loss beside an unchanged quantizer). OPEN: whether the unshown SPEC EQUATIONS supply the missing switches for behcone/LORENTZ.

STAGE 2 - EVIDENCE GROUNDING. GOAL: tie each proposal to the shared observed evidence E5-E11. READ: E5 entropy stratification; E6 width-20 beam survival and recall@10; E7 teacher-forced per-position NLL; E8 first-level capacity ceiling; E9 cohort-profile signal; E10 transition graph; E11 same-first-prefix vs permuted null. OBSERVED: E5 top-1 successor mass 0.4375 in the lowest entropy quintile vs 0.0543 in the highest, Spearman(entropy, top-1 mass) = -0.973; E6 best recall 0.06363 (resample), euclid/l1 variants 0.06207-0.06233, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic 0.05500/0.05463, tangent 0.05500, target 0.065; E7 l1_br_euclid and l1_only have T1 NLL 0.00 while resample has T1 4.55 and the best recall; E8 same-cluster share K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822; E9 positive shares a successor cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871 for negatives, profile entropy 1.65 nats over 7.5 cohorts; E10 115582 distinct edges, mean out-degree 5.45; E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067. REASONING: (a) the binding failure is full-SID beam inclusion / depth-3 and depth-4 survival, not level-1 predictability, so a level-1-only mechanism is aimed at a non-binding position; (b) CURVCTRL is the only design that sets a separate curvature per RQ level from a per-level measured statistic, so it can reach the deeper levels where E6/E7 put the failure; (c) succboost has the strongest measured behaviour field (E5) and reallocates the E8 level-1 capacity, but E6's successor_entropy/geodesic variants are the worst measured; (d) LORENTZ's successor-profile signal is real (E9/E10) but modest, and its 50/50 Minkowski blur threatens the content fidelity that separates the 0.062-0.064 variants from the 0.051-0.055 ones. OPEN: single-run seed noise cannot be resolved within policy.

STAGE 3 - RANKING DECISION. GOAL: place every proposal with no ties and no gaps. DECISION: 1 CURVCTRL-SID, 2 succboost-geoshift, 3 LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, 4 behcone-prefix-rq. BASIS: CURVCTRL has the strongest coupled pathway (measured per-level prefix statistic -> derived per-level curvature -> same-level assignment and commitment), is the only mechanism reaching all RQ levels where E6/E7 locate the failure, and is one of only two with all three switches plus derived caps/floors in the frozen text; its weak Q_l margin (E11 0.0907 vs 0.067) is the main risk. succboost has the best-measured behaviour field (E5) and matches E8 capacity pressure with explicit switches, but it is radial-only and E6's nearest analogues (successor_entropy 0.0512, successor_geodesic 0.055) underperformed the euclid 0.062 variants. LORENTZ is supported by E9/E10 and directly targets the E8/E11 same-prefix gap, but smoothing risks reconstruction and off switches are absent. behcone acts only on level 1, which E7 shows is already perfectly predicted in the strong SIDs, leaves the quantizer unchanged, and has no explicit switches. OPEN: the winner still has to clear the single frozen Stage-3 run, and the Q_l trajectory or radius-beta correlation is the only internal check that the coupling fired.

FINAL ANSWER (rank-2026-10-v1):
RANK: CURVCTRL-SID | position=1 | reason=Only proposal whose measured per-level prefix statistic sets a per-level curvature used inside the same level's assignment and commitment, so it can reach the depth-3/4 survival collapse that E6/E7 identify as the binding failure; it also has derived caps/floors and all three switches explicit, with E11's same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067 as its (weak but non-zero) state variable.
RANK: succboost-geoshift | position=2 | reason=Its behaviour signal is the best-measured one (E5 top-1 successor mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973) and it reallocates level-1 capacity in the direction E8 says matters (K=256 cohesion 0.0822 vs 0.3106 at K=16), with explicit switches and no competing loss; but it is radial-only and E6's nearest analogues (successor_entropy 0.0512, successor_geodesic 0.0550) are the worst measured, so it ranks behind CURVCTRL.
RANK: LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ | position=3 | reason=Successor-profile equivalence is observed and non-degenerate (E9 positives share a successor cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871 negatives, profile entropy 1.65 over 7.5 cohorts) and it directly targets the E8/E11 same-prefix gap, but the 50/50 Minkowski smoothing risks the content fidelity that E6 shows separates the 0.062-0.064 variants from the 0.051-0.055 ones, and the frozen text gives no off switches.
RANK: behcone-prefix-rq | position=4 | reason=It acts on level 1 only, but E7 shows the strong SIDs already have T1 NLL 0.00 (l1_br_euclid, l1_only) while the best-recall resample has T1 4.55, and E6's closest measured analogue successor_entropy is 0.0512; the quantizer is left unchanged and no off switches are specified, so it is aimed at a non-binding position at the weakest coupling.
